title: Yellowfin Australian Fish Sushi
description: A jammy and glassy-jelly Australian dish featuring canola oil, perfect for a date night, made with yellowfin fish and shaped into nigiri, ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly
instructions: Prepare the sushi rice according to the package instructions
Cut the yellowfin fish into small pieces and set aside
Heat the canola oil in a pan over medium heat
Add the sugar and salt to the pan and stir until dissolved
Add the fish pieces to the pan and cook for 2 minutes on each side
Prepare the norii sheets by cutting them into small squares
Assemble the nigiri by shaping the sushi rice into small balls and topping with a piece of fish and a norii square
Serve the nigiri with wasabi and pickled ginger on the side
Drizzle the canola oil mixture over the top of the nigiri
